description: Ukraine - Electricity Planning Model is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities, Resource assessments", published or maintained by WBG Power Systems Planning Team (World Bank Group). The Power Systems Planning Group, embedded in the Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP), has created the Electricity Planning Model (EPM) as a least-cost planning framework. EPM minimizes the costs of expanding and operating a power system while meeting the model's technical, economic, and environmental requirements. Coverage: Ukraine. It has 1 file in XLS. The portal files it under Power system and utilities, Resource assessments. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
